text:
Another dramatic weekend across Europe delivered several major surprises, with Bet365 holding a slight overall edge while the model managed some standout reads in Spain and France.

Looking ahead to the upcoming round, one fixture in particular warrants a closer look. In La Liga, the model gives Osasuna a 30.3% chance of taking three points away at Sevilla, compared to the 23.8% chance assessed by Bet365. With an away win priced at 4.2 odds, the model sees a 20.0% expected value, marking the round's clearest divergence between the two.

Turning to the latest matches, evaluated by log loss where a lower number indicates better performance, Serie A proved treacherous. The model suffered its heaviest miss when Venezia stunned Napoli 1-0; having assigned Napoli a 72.9% win chance, the model returned a steep log loss of 2.258 against Bet365's 1.653. The model was also caught out in the Bundesliga, where Elversberg edged Augsburg 4-3 despite the model giving Augsburg a 63.9% chance. In the Premier League, Chelsea’s 2-0 win at Everton was another spot where Bet365 correctly favoured the visitors while the model backed the hosts.

There were strong successes for the model as well. In Spain, it was far more bullish than the bookmaker on Osasuna's 2-0 victory over Santander, estimating a 66.0% chance and securing a sharp 0.415 log loss compared to Bet365's 0.740. It also enjoyed an emphatic read in Ligue 1, giving Lens a 67.6% chance in their 3-1 win at Troyes. That performance helped the model keep a narrow lead over Bet365 in France over the season so far, logging an overall loss of 0.980 to 0.984.
